svg.title: Which recovery path applies to which loss
svg.desc: A decision tree with one question at the top: do you still have your recovery phrase. If yes, the path depends on the loss. A forgotten password, a lost or wiped device, or a browser profile that was reset all recover by installing the extension and importing the phrase. If you still have access and suspect the phrase was exposed, move the funds to a wallet built from a new phrase, because a phrase cannot be changed. If you no longer have the phrase and the wallet still opens, export and move the funds now, then start again from a phrase you have written down. If you no longer have the phrase and the wallet does not open, the funds cannot be recovered by anyone, including Universe.
svg.text: Everything depends on one question.
Do you still have your recovery phrase?
The 12 words. Not the password, which is device-local.
YES
NO
Forgot the password
Lost, broke or wiped the device
Browser profile was reset
Install the extension, choose Import, enter the phrase.
Your accounts and balances come back from the chain.
You think the phrase was seen
A phrase cannot be changed. Changing the password
does not help.
Create a wallet from a new phrase and move everything
to it, starting with the largest balance.
The wallet still opens
Act now, while you still can.
Export the phrase from Settings and write it down, or
move the funds to a wallet whose phrase you do have.
One browser reset ends this option.
The wallet does not open
The funds cannot be recovered. Not by you, not by
Universe, not by anyone.
Self-custody has no reset link. This is the reason the
phrase is worth writing down before you deposit.
Universe never holds your keys, so it cannot see your phrase, freeze an account, reverse a transaction, or restore a wallet on your behalf.
